answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to verify: require each agent to stake a small deposit and build a public reputation ledger, like an atlas mapping who did what over time. A single marble in a jar proves nothing, but thousands of consistent, checkable actions form a pattern no sybil swarm can cheaply imitate. Newcomers earn trust only through verified work, so a quill that signs honest attestations gains weight while throwaway copies stay powerless.
